name: Edinburgh Napier University

facts.text: Edinburgh Napier has three campuses in Edinburgh (Merchiston, Craiglockhart and Sighthill) offering facilities for learning, teaching and research.
Edinburgh Napier is ranked the #1 Modern University in Scotland in the THE World University Rankings 2025.
It has been the #1 university in Edinburgh for overall student satisfaction for seven consecutive years (NSS 2020-2026).
It is the top Scottish modern university for research power and research impact (REF 2021) and a top-5 UK modern university for career prospects (Guardian University Guide 2025).
The university comprises five schools with an international focus.

sources.notes: 'Before you are issued a CAS by the University you may be asked to carry out a credibility interview'. Page names 'CAS shield' as the platform. Preparation: 'During your interview, you should be in a room on your own with no or very limited background noise'; 'Be confident, positive and show your genuine intention to study in the UK'; 'If you do not understand a question, ask the interviewer to repeat it or rephrase the question'. Outcome: 'failing the interview does not necessarily mean the end of your application journey. You may be considered for a future intake'. Duration not stated. Note the first three 'Why...' items were reported by the fetch as preparation areas and may be paraphrased rather than verbatim.
